extension.summary: P2PBG torrent streaming via Elementum (with VPN gate)
extension.description: Fork of plugin.video.p2pbg 2026.09.24.01 by MartinStZ (GPL-3.0): browse, search and stream p2pbg.com torrents through the Elementum engine, with a fail-closed VPN country gate added before playback.
extension.disclaimer: Requires an Elementum installation for torrent streaming and a p2pbg.com account. This add-on stores your tracker credentials only in local Kodi settings.
extension.news: Navigation fix: a click that arrives without its mode parameter now shows the requested listing instead of re-rendering the main menu; the plugin opens the last used category instead of the redundant main menu (setting start_at_last, with a Меню entry in every listing); the root menu is explicitly content-type files so it always renders as folders; plugin queries are parsed with parse_qsl; Diagnostics now shows the last call, listing, table and item count. Playback and browsing unchanged.
